rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to say that an action or payment is required.

example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1 cin2

rows.note: Use this when the requirement is imposed or coercive, especially in descriptions of official measures.

example.english: This measure is compulsory, and all employees must comply.
example.traditional: 呢項措施具有強制性，所有僱員都必須遵守。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 cou3 si1 geoi6 jau5 koeng4 zai3 sing3 so2 jau5 gu3 jyun4 dou1 bit1 seoi1 zeon1 sau2
